text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I was thinking of putting up<n>my posters for
my concert here, but<n>what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Us students are always checking<n>here for the latest
news, so surely<n>everyone will see it, right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Plus, all the students who find out<n>they need to take
supplementary<n>lessons will cheer up when they
see<n>my peppy poster!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, but what if... I need to take<n>supplementary
lessons too...
